Jesmina Khatun @ Jasmina Khatun vs The State Of West
Bengal on 2 December, 2025
02.12.2025
Ct. No.42
D/L 100
Mujahid
 Crr 5096 of 2025
 Jesmina Khatun @ Jasmina Khatun
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal
 Mr. Diptangshu Bsu
 Mr. Karan Bapuli
 Ms. Suparna Chakraborty
 ...for the petitioner

1. 
Present petition has been filed for expeditious disposal of G.R. 2260/2023 arising out of Monteswar
P.S. Case No.546/2023 dated 27.09.2023 under Sections 498A/323/120B/504/506 of the Ipc read
with Sections  of the Dowry Prohibition Act pending before the learned Additional Chief Judicial
Magistrate, Kalna, Purba Bardhaman.
2. Issue notice to the State of West Bengal through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor.
3. Let a status report be also called from the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kalna,
5. Let the matter be listed in the combined monthly list of February, 2026.

(Dinesh Kumar Sharma, J.)
